# Codebase Report: Rectangle Drawing in PoisonLog

## 1. Overview / App Structure

This is a **Qt 6 QML (Quick) app** — no QWidgets, no `.pro` file. There is no C++ main-window widget; all UI is QML, and the rectangle feature is fully QML-driven with C++ behind it as a model/store.

- **Build system: CMake** (`/home/dwight/git/poisonlog/CMakeLists.txt`), Qt 6.12 required, `AUTOMOC` on, C++20.
- C++ backend lives in `src/` (static lib `poisonlog_core`, lines 22–35); QML lives in `qml/` and is registered via `qt_add_qml_module` (lines 50–60).
- Entry point: `src/main.cpp` — creates `AppStore` and registers it as QML singleton `App` (line 21), loads `Main.qml` (line 26).

QML component hierarchy:
- `qml/Main.qml` — root window; hosts `MapView` (`qml/Main.qml:93`) and `EditorPanel` (`qml/Main.qml:100`).
- `qml/MapView.qml` — **the annotation canvas** (map image + drawn rectangles).
- `qml/MapCanvas.qml` — interactive tile map used only on the setup page (`MapSetupPage.qml:138`); no rectangles here, just pan/zoom.
- `qml/EditorPanel.qml` — side editor (delete, color, commit etc.).

## 2. Rectangle drawing, storage, and mouse events

### Mouse events — all in `qml/MapView.qml`

- **Create (rubber-band drag on empty map)**: `MouseArea id: createArea`, lines **35–90**.
  - `onPressed` starts drawing (line 55), `onPositionChanged` live-updates the rubber band (line 67), `onReleased` calls `App.addDraftRectangle(...)` (lines 78–84, via `finish()` at lines 46–53 with a 0.01 minimum size).
- **Move existing rectangle**: `MouseArea id: moveArea` inside each delegate item, lines **122–155**.
  - `onPressed` records the press point and original rx/ry in *normalized* coords (134–141); `onPositionChanged` maps pointer delta to normalized coords and calls `App.updateDraftRectangle(index, nx, ny, rw, rh, false)` (143–152); `onReleased` calls `App.saveDraftRectangles()` (line 154). Cursor: `Qt.SizeAllCursor` (line 127).
- **Resize (existing handle)**: a 14×14 `Rectangle` handle anchored at bottom-right with its own `MouseArea`, lines **157–201**.
  - Same press/move/release pattern; `onPositionChanged` calls `App.updateDraftRectangle(index, rx, ry, nw, nh, false)` (188–197). Cursor: `Qt.SizeFDiagCursor` (line 172). Hit-testing is implicit via the MouseArea with `anchors.margins: -5` (line 170).
  - Note: this is the **only** handle — a single bottom-right diag resize handle; no per-edge/corner handles, no hit-test loop.
- **Panning the live map canvas** (`MapCanvas.qml`, unrelated to rects): `MouseArea` lines **152–172**.

### Where rectangles are painted

No C++ `paintEvent` anywhere — rectangles are painted by QML `Rectangle` items:

- Persisted/drafted rectangles: `Repeater { model: App.rectanglesModel }` delegates, `qml/MapView.qml:92–203`. Each item's position/size derived from normalized roles: `x: rx * root.width`, `y: ry * root.width`... (lines 105–108), border colored/thickened when selected (lines 111–113), translucent fill overlay lines 115–120.
- Rubber band while drawing: `Rectangle id: rubber`, `qml/MapView.qml:205–218`.

## 3. Geometry storage

Geometry is stored as **normalized [0..1] doubles** (fractions of the map image size), not `QRect`:

- `src/rectanglelistmodel.h:6–12` — `struct MapRectangle { double x, y, w, h; QString color; }`; model `RectangleListModel` (`m_rectangles` QVector, line 46) with roles `rx/ry/rw/rh/rColor` (`src/rectanglelistmodel.cpp:35–44`).
- Persistence type: `src/database.h:38–45` — `Database::Rect { double x, y, w, h; int sort; QString color; }`, stored in SQLite `rectangles` table (`src/database.cpp:122`), read via `Database::rectangles()` (`src/database.cpp:429`) and written via `replaceRectangles()` (`src/database.cpp:460`).
- Orchestrator: `AppStore` (`src/appstore.h/`.cpp) — `m_rectangles` member (`appstore.h:186`), exposed as `App.rectanglesModel` (`appstore.h:45`).
  - `addDraftRectangle` `src/appstore.cpp:683–712` (clamps, min size `MinimumRectangleSize = 0.005` line 15, auto-selects new rect)
  - `updateDraftRectangle` `src/appstore.cpp:714–735`
  - `saveDraftRectangles` `src/appstore.cpp:737–750`; `removeDraftRectangle` 752–774; `deleteSelectedRectangle` 776–780; `selectRectangle` 782–790 (selection via `m_selectedRectangleIndex`, `appstore.h:209`)
  - `persistDraftRectangles()` at `src/appstore.cpp:981`

## 4. Existing handle-drag infrastructure (summary)

- One corner resize handle per rect (bottom-right) + whole-rect move, both with dedicated `MouseArea`s, per-delegate property caching (`pressX/pressY/origX/origY/origW/origH`), cursor shapes (`SizeAllCursor`, `SizeFDiagCursor`), and normalization math (viewport-pixel delta → normalized delta).
- There is **no generic hit-testing code** — Qt MouseAreas handle bounds; no edge handles exist today. To add more handles you'd replicate the pattern in `qml/MapView.qml:157–201`, changing anchors and cursor (`Qt.SizeHorCursor`/`SizeVerCursor`/etc.) and clamping in `updateDraftRectangle` (C++ also enforces clamp/min-size, `appstore.cpp:722–725`).

- New C++ class in `src/`: add `.h`/`.cpp` paths to the `qt_add_library(poisonlog_core ...)` list (lines 22–35). `AUTOMOC` handles Q_OBJECT.
- New QML file: add to the `qt_add_qml_module` `QML_FILES` list (lines 50–60); it becomes part of the `PoisonLog 1.0` module URI.
- Tests: add a `qt_add_executable` + `add_test` block like lines 66–72, linking `poisonlog_core Qt6::Test`. Existing test examples: `tests/tst_database.cpp`, `tests/tst_appstore.cpp`.
